messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 1952468100 smart-routing-fallback spike detected in hosted-api-prod — elevated error rate + region fallbacks. Impact: degraded latencies and increased 5xxs for ~20% of requests. Auto-pager sent to #oncall and #incidents.

marta-oncall: paging oncall. I'm looking now. seeing repeat failures in EU region, then clients retrying -> more fallbacks.

sam-rt: I can see it in the routing logs: a policy mismatch caused some requests to prefer a 'quantized-v2' variant that isn't compatible with short-seq optimization. That variant is failing prewarm checks so traffic is being sent to fallback pool in us-west-2.

jin-engruntime: timeline from logs: 14:02:12 many requests hit model-variant selection (policy eval) -> 14:02:14 worker init errors for quantized-v2 -> 14:02:15 router fallback to us-west -> 14:02:16 client retries start (backoff 0.5s) -> 14:02:18 surge in fallback pool.

harper-sre: confirmed thundering herd pattern. Retry storms + fallback doubling traffic. Cache hit rate dropped. CPU/GPU saturating on fallback nodes.

elaine-cs: we have customer reports: some customers seeing timeouts and 502s; one premium customer reported 30% of calls failing. Raising priority.

marta-oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) disable smart-routing policy that maps to quantized-v2 (temp) 2) raise rate-limit on fallback pool to protect control plane 3) notify customers in-flight via status page draft. Doing 1) now.

sam-rt: copying config diff:
```
- routing.policies.smart_variants.enabled = true
+ routing.policies.smart_variants.enabled = false  # rollback - emergency
```
Applying now to hosted-api-prod.

ops-bot: deploy-started by marta-oncall: rollback smart_variants -> rolling to routers (6 nodes).

jin-engruntime: take note: disabling smart routing will cause a direct mapping to stable variants; that should stop variant misselection and reduce failovers. Also suggest tightening client retry windows while we stabilize.

harper-sre: scaling fallback pool up by 2x while we clear the backlog. Spinning additional instances in us-west and eu-central.

elaine-cs: posted initial status: "We are seeing elevated errors for some API calls due to routing/fallback issues; mitigation in progress". Customers on support loop pinged.

marta-oncall: routers rolled; monitoring... latency and error rates dropping but still elevated.

sam-rt: logs show client retry amplification continues because many SDKs use exponential backoff starting at 0.5s with max tries 5. Recommend a temporary client-side advisory to increase initial backoff and cap retries.

jin-engruntime: creating a short-lived rate-limit override in front of fallback pool: set `x-rl` to 50 rps per customer to prevent amplification. Applying.

ops-bot: ratelimit-change applied by jin-engruntime.

harper-sre: GPU load trending down, error rate down to baseline for most customers. A handful of heavy customers still showing retry patterns.

marta-oncall: contacting SDK owners: @sam-rt can we push a micro-update to runtimes to set default retry to 2 and initial backoff 1s?

sam-rt: yes, I can push a patch to SDK today. Will also add server-side guidance to README and status note.

elaine-cs: support message template ready: "We identified a routing misconfiguration that caused fallbacks and amplified retries; mitigation applied. We recommend clients upgrade SDK x.y.z or adjust retry config temporarily."

jin-engruntime: long-term actions noted: 1) validate model variant compatibility in policy evaluation (add a safety check) 2) add circuit-breaker on fallback routing to avoid cascading failovers 3) improve router telemetry for retry amplification signals.

harper-sre: creating oncall follow-up runbook item: if fallback traffic increases by >25% within 2m, auto-throttle routing and alert platform owners.

marta-oncall: we're stabilizing. preparing incident channel for postmortem. Anyone object to declaring P1 mitigated and switch to P2 for follow-up?

sam-rt: agree. P1 mitigated. start postmortem ticket.

ops-bot: incident-metric-snapshot: peak error rate 18% at 14:02:45, peak fallback delta +3.6x, mitigation applied 14:08:22.

elaine-cs: customer outreach ongoing. Collecting affected tenant IDs and timelines.

jin-engruntime: saving config diffs and adding test for policy -> variant compatibility. I'll open a PR referencing this incident.

harper-sre: adding follow-up ops tasks: capacity hardening, add LD flag to disable smart routing per-customer, and improve default retry guidance in docs.

marta-oncall: final checks: error rate at 1.2% and falling, latency back to normal. I'll handoff to sam for follow-up and to jin for runtime fixes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam-rt: I'll own postmortem draft and SDK advisory. tagging @product for customer comms.

jin-engruntime: I'll own runtime PR and router telemetry changes.

incident-bot: Incident 1952468100 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem required.

marta-oncall: closing active pager. moving channel to read-only for postmortem notes.

elaine-cs: leaving a copy of the customer impact summary here for the postmortem: "~8 customers affected, 2 premium with >20% errors over 6m. No data loss. Several calls retried automatically by clients leading to transient overload."

sam-rt: starting postmortem doc outline. Will include timeline, root cause (policy mapped to incompatible model variant), amplification mechanism (client retries + router fallback doubling traffic), mitigations, and action items.

harper-sre: creating follow-up JIRAs and assigning owners.

ops-bot: incident-archived to incident-tracker:ID-INC-2026-487.

marta-oncall: thanks team. Leaving notes in oncall log and handoff to next shift. Anyone else?

elaine-cs: no, closing.

sam-rt: thanks :raised_hands:

jin-engruntime: good job everyone.
